name: Leaderboarded
author: caspii

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress site into a competitive hub — in under 5 minutes.

Leaderboarded is the easiest way to embed a live, animated leaderboard into any WordPress post or page. Just paste a shortcode and your leaderboard appears, fully hosted and automatically updated in real-time. No coding, no database setup, no headaches.

Whether you’re running a sales competition, a team challenge, or a gamified community — Leaderboarded gives you a professional leaderboard that people actually want to look at.

Why Leaderboarded?

Most teams track performance in spreadsheets that nobody checks. Leaderboarded turns that data into something visual, competitive, and motivating — embedded right where your audience already is.

Real-time updates. When you change a score on Leaderboarded.com, your embedded leaderboard updates automatically. No page refresh needed. No manual re-publishing.

Beautiful out of the box. Animated rankings, multiple themes, and customizable colors make your leaderboard look polished without any design work.

Mobile-friendly management. Update scores from your phone, tablet, or laptop. The admin interface works on any device.

Multiple leaderboard types. Choose between individual leaderboards, team leaderboards, and click counters — whatever fits your use case.

Dead simple to embed. One shortcode is all it takes: [leaderboarded token="your-token"]. If you can paste text, you can embed a leaderboard.

Perfect For

  • Sales team performance tracking
  • Employee recognition and competitions
  • Fundraising campaigns and progress trackers
  • Training and certification leaderboards
  • Community challenges and contests
  • Any ranking or scoring you want to make visible and engaging

How It Works

  1. Install the Leaderboarded plugin
  2. Create a leaderboard on Leaderboarded.com (requires a PRO plan)
  3. Copy the shortcode from the “Share” menu
  4. Paste it into any post or page — done

Your leaderboard is hosted on Leaderboarded.com and embedded via a secure iframe. That means fast loading, zero server load on your WordPress installation, and automatic updates whenever you change scores.

Requires a PRO Plan

Embedding leaderboards into WordPress requires a PRO plan on Leaderboarded.com. Setup takes under 5 minutes and you can start with a free trial.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without a Leaderboarded.com account?

No. This plugin embeds leaderboards that are hosted and managed on Leaderboarded.com. You’ll need to create an account there and upgrade to a PRO plan to use the WordPress embedding feature.

Is this a paid feature?

Yes. Embedding leaderboards into WordPress requires a PRO plan on Leaderboarded.com. You can create and share leaderboards for free — the WordPress embed is a PRO feature.

How do I create my first leaderboard and get the shortcode?

Everything starts on Leaderboarded.com:

  1. Create a leaderboard here
  2. Add your participants and scores
  3. Click the “Share” button at the top of your leaderboard
  4. Click “Embed on a website”
  5. Copy the shortcode — it will look like [leaderboarded token="rvfafgignlr"]

How do I add the shortcode to a WordPress post or page?

Once the plugin is installed and activated:

  1. Open the post or page you want to edit
  2. Add a new block and type “/” to open the block picker
  3. Select “Shortcode” from the list
  4. Paste your shortcode — for example: [leaderboarded token="rvfafgignlr"]
  5. Save your post — the leaderboard will appear immediately

Do scores update automatically?

Yes. Scores update in real-time without any page refresh. When you update a score, add a new participant, or change colors on Leaderboarded.com, your embedded leaderboard reflects those changes automatically. Your visitors always see the current standings.

What types of leaderboards can I embed?

You can embed three types of boards:

  • Individual leaderboards — rank people by score
  • Team leaderboards — rank groups or departments
  • Click counters — track votes, nominations, or button presses

Can I customize how the leaderboard looks?

Yes. Leaderboarded.com offers multiple themes and custom color options. All visual changes you make there are reflected automatically in your embedded leaderboard.

How do I update scores after embedding?

Log in to Leaderboarded.com and update your leaderboard there. Changes appear in your embedded WordPress leaderboard in real-time — no need to edit your post or touch the shortcode.

I have a question or need help

Email us at hi@leaderboarded.com — we’re happy to help.

How do I uninstall the plugin?

Deactivate and delete the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen. Your leaderboards on Leaderboarded.com are unaffected.
